subject: c-fo-act
title: C.FO.ACT.------SOC.RT.
description: Diagram in NYM-30. C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) is crossed with SOC-RT (social reality) — what does post-Ayler composite focused activism do to social reality? Besides the main line to SOC-RT (the crossing), one line leaves the subject, to POL-DYM (political dynamics). From the POL-DYM line branch ALT-F (alternative functionalism) → DEC (decentralization), and DYM-F (dynamic functionalism), from whose line hang LK-IMP (linkage implications), TRS (transition) and CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis).
